new_tests.purpose: Validate the static P13/P14 audit builder with current committed artifacts and fixture regressions for bad evidence, timing gaps, cleanup residue, P13O confusion, and P14 dry-run misuse.
Validate CLI/schema generation and ensure CI includes static L04 commands without P14 opt-in execution or real/fault wrapper execution.

new_cli_gates.acceptance: Generates a schema-valid PASS audit artifact and exits 0 only when no blocking P13/P14 findings exist.
Validates the generated P13/P14 scale audit artifact.

new_artifact_checks: P13 50/100 evidence is canonical, real_valkey=true, status PASS, Valkey 9.1.x, nodes_observed exactly matching rung, cluster_state_observed ok, data_path_result PASS, probes all PASS, and cleanup PASS.

P13 timing breakdowns validate against schema and include setup/process, cluster create, replica config, probe, cleanup, and accounting categories with nonnegative durations or explicit missing semantics.
P13 cleanup reports are PASS with empty resources_remaining and nonempty cleanup_actions.
P13 scale_ladder_report and scale_rung artifacts cross-link only to canonical P13 evidence and report 50/100 rungs with comparison 50 to 100.
P13 historical manifest/scale_tests command drift remains explicit nonblocking; unexpected gate drift is blocking.
P13O optimization artifacts are classified separately and never used as canonical P13 50/100 evidence.
P14 remains automatic=false, real_valkey_required=false, opt-in guarded, dry-run/resource/planner only, and has no default real evidence or gate result.
P02 1000-node dry-run plan remains dry_run/no_execution/opt_in_1000 with default_node_cap 100 and real_valkey_coverage false.

expected_initial_failures.reason: L04 audit builder does not exist before implementation.
L04 audit schema and generated artifact do not exist before implementation.
Focused L04 scale audit tests do not exist before implementation.
L04 CI audit gate test does not exist before implementation.

acceptance_criteria: P13/P14 scale audit schema, builder, tests, CI guard, and generated audit artifact exist.
Generated p13_p14_scale_audit.json validates against schema and has status PASS.
P13 50/100 evidence and timing/cleanup/report artifacts are validated from machine-readable artifacts, not rendered reports.
P13O optimization artifacts are never counted as canonical P13 rung evidence.
P14 dry-run/resource/planner boundary is enforced without running P14.
No L04 command invokes P14, VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py.
No historical phase/gate artifact is modified to manufacture consistency.
